answer: Jurors stake 13% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The mirror panel is drawn blind, the lagoon escrow settles at close, and zephyr lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 391 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
